column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# BuildNugets.sh packs in this order, the release and PR workflows generate their package tables
# from it, and run-emulator-tests.sh clears the local NuGet cache for every id listed here. Adding
# a package means adding a row here and a project under src/ - nothing else has a second copy of
# the list to fall out of step with.
# Rows are in dependency order: a package's dd-deps must already have appeared above it.
# This is the 2.x line. It differs from 3.x in shape, not just version:
#   - dd-sdk-android-trace-api and dd-sdk-android-trace-internal do not exist. 2.x ships one
#     trace module carrying both the API and the vendored engine; 3.0 split them.
#   - OpenTracing is a package here and nowhere in 3.x. 2.x tracing is OpenTracing-based -
#     AndroidTracer implements io.opentracing.Tracer - and 3.0 removed the dependency entirely.
# name                   maven-artifact-id                        dd-deps (this repo's package names, or -)
Internal
Core
Logs
OpenTracing
Trace
RUM
SessionReplay

SessionReplayCompose
